name: שברים חלקיים – בחירת הצורה המתאימה עם גורם ריבועי אי-פריק (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Select the appropriate format for expressing the following rational function in partial fractions.

\[ f(x) = {{CT:0}} \]

\[ (1) = \frac{A}{x-{{CT:1}}} + \frac{B}{x-{{CT:1}}} + \frac{C}{{CT:2}},\quad (2) = \frac{A}{(x-{{CT:1}})^2} + \frac{B}{x-{{CT:1}}} + \frac{C x + D}{{CT:2}}, \]

\[ (3) = \frac{A}{(x-{{CT:1}})^2} + \frac{B}{x-{{CT:1}}} + \frac{C}{{CT:2}},\quad (4) = \frac{A}{x-{{CT:1}}} + \frac{B}{x-{{CT:1}}} + \frac{C x + D}{{CT:2}}. \]

Format [[input:af]]
[[validation:af]]

Calculate the unknown coefficients. Enter these in the correct order as a list, i.e. \([A,B,C,D]\) below, inserting a zero for any unused coefficients.

[[input:ans1]]
[[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
Outline: The denominator has a repeated linear factor and an irreducible quadratic factor, which gives format 2. The constants come from substituting \(x\) values and matching coefficients.
Step 1 — The format

\[ f(x) = {{CT:0}} \]

To express as partial fractions let

\[ {{CT:0}}= \frac{A}{{CT:3}}+\frac{B}{{CT:4}}+\frac{Cx+D}{{CT:2}}, \mbox{ which is format 2.} \]

Step 2 — Clearing the denominator
Multiplying throughout by {{CT:5}} gives

\[ {{CT:6}}=A({{CT:2}})+B({{CT:4}})({{CT:2}})+(Cx+D){{CT:3}} \]

Step 3 — Substituting values of \(x\)
Let \(x = {{CT:1}}\), therefore

\[ {{CT:7}}={{CT:8}} \]

\[ A=\frac{{CT:7}}{{CT:9}}={{CT:10}} \]

Let \(x = 0\), therefore

\[ {{CT:11}}=A({{CT:12}})+B({{CT:13}})({{CT:12}})+D({{CT:14}})={{CT:15}} \]

\[ {{CT:16}} ={{CT:17}} \]

Step 4 — Matching coefficients
Equate coefficients of \(x^3\)

\[ {{CT:18}} = B+C \]

Equate coefficients of \(x^2\)

\[ {{CT:19}} = {{CT:20}}={{CT:21}} \]

\[ {{CT:22}} = {{CT:23}} \]

Solving the 4 equations in \(A,B,C\) and \(D\) gives

\[ {{CT:24}} \]

on_true.feedback: You have got the right format.

on_false.feedback: You have the wrong form, so I can't consider your answer to the second part.
